question: Which of the following institutes launched Bharat Cancer Genome Atlas in February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Institute of Technology, Madras**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Indian Institute of Technology, Madras** launched the **Bharat Cancer Genome Atlas (BCGA)** initiative to collect comprehensive cancer genome data specific to the Indian population.
 
• The initiative was developed in collaboration with several research organizations and hospitals across India to improve cancer diagnosis and treatment.
 
• **BCGA** aims to create a database of genetic mutations in cancer patients, helping researchers develop personalized cancer therapies.
 
• The project focuses on studying the unique genetic, lifestyle, and environmental factors contributing to cancer prevalence in India.
 
• Through BCGA, IIT Madras is leveraging advanced technologies like next-generation sequencing and bioinformatics to analyze cancer genomes efficiently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharat Cancer Genome Atlas**:

 
 
• The Bharat Cancer Genome Atlas (BCGA) is an ambitious initiative aimed at creating a comprehensive database of genetic mutations in cancer patients across India.
 
• The project is inspired by the global **Cancer Genome Atlas**, which has significantly advanced cancer research worldwide.
 
• By focusing on India’s diverse population, BCGA aims to uncover unique genetic and environmental risk factors for cancer, paving the way for personalized medicine.
